participant_id.Description: BIDS participant label (single patient of the case study)

source_id.Description: Patient code used in the release (SEEG84)

age.Description: Age of the patient: 'a 32-year-old right-handed male' (Bratu et al. 2021, Cortex 145:285-294, doi:10.1016/j.cortex.2021.08.018, section 2 'Patient and methods'). The article does not state the recording year.

sex.Description: Sex of the patient ('male'; Bratu et al. 2021, Cortex 145:285-294, doi:10.1016/j.cortex.2021.08.018, section 2 'Patient and methods')

handedness.Description: Handedness ('right-handed'; Bratu et al. 2021, Cortex 145:285-294, doi:10.1016/j.cortex.2021.08.018, section 2 'Patient and methods')

diagnosis.Description: Clinical diagnosis: 'a drug resistant epilepsy patient' explored with SEEG (Bratu et al. 2021, Cortex 145:285-294, doi:10.1016/j.cortex.2021.08.018, abstract; Dryad record abstract). Full text: drug-resistant epilepsy, considered a surgical candidate (Bratu et al. 2021, Cortex 145:285-294, doi:10.1016/j.cortex.2021.08.018, section 2 'Patient and methods').

lesion.Description: Lesion covered by the implantation: 'electrodes covering the right posterior temporal PVNH and the adjacent cortex' (periventricular nodular heterotopia; Bratu et al. 2021, Cortex 145:285-294, doi:10.1016/j.cortex.2021.08.018, abstract)

implant_type.Description: Type of intracranial implantation (stereo-electroencephalography, depth electrodes; abstract; electrodes.tsv type=depth)

implanted_hemispheres.Description: Hemispheres with implanted contacts, from the hemisphere column of the authors' Contact_coordinates.xlsx (sub-01_space-Other_electrodes.tsv): 198 contacts on 13 right-hemisphere electrodes (I, A, B, F, L, D, Q, K, U, R, P, C, S) and 48 contacts on 3 left-hemisphere electrodes (X', Y', F')

n_electrodes.Description: Number of SEEG electrodes (shafts) with contact coordinates in the release (electrodes.tsv column group)

n_contacts.Description: Number of SEEG contacts with coordinates in the release (Contact_coordinates.xlsx -> electrodes.tsv)

stimulated_contacts.Description: Bipolar contact pair in the PVNH used for the 43 Hz and single-pulse stimulations (AnyWave markers '43Hz D08-D09 ...' and 'SPES D08 D09'; Dryad ReadMe: PVNH stimulation)

epilepsy_onset_age.Description: Age at epilepsy onset: 'suffered from epilepsy since the age of 13' (Bratu et al. 2021, Cortex 145:285-294, doi:10.1016/j.cortex.2021.08.018, section 2 'Patient and methods')

seizure_onset.Description: Video-EEG: 'ictal electrical onset in the right posterior quadrant' (Bratu et al. 2021, Cortex 145:285-294, doi:10.1016/j.cortex.2021.08.018, section 2 'Patient and methods')

epileptogenic_zone_seeg.Description: SEEG: 'Ictal recordings showed an epileptogenic zone that involved the PVNH, the right posterior hippocampus and temporo-basal regions' (Bratu et al. 2021, Cortex 145:285-294, doi:10.1016/j.cortex.2021.08.018, section 2 'Patient and methods')

n_electrodes_paper.Description: Number of depth electrodes stated in the article: 'SEEG exploration was performed using 15 depth electrodes with 12-18 contacts' (Bratu et al. 2021, Cortex 145:285-294, doi:10.1016/j.cortex.2021.08.018, section 2 'Patient and methods'). Differs from n_electrodes (16, counted from the released Contact_coordinates.xlsx); both kept as stated.

n_contacts_paper.Description: Number of intracranial contacts stated in the article ('From 214 contacts placed intracranially'; Bratu et al. 2021, Cortex 145:285-294, doi:10.1016/j.cortex.2021.08.018, section 2 'Patient and methods'). Differs from n_contacts (246, counted from the released coordinates); both kept as stated.

n_contacts_recorded_paper.Description: Contacts selected for continuous recording: 'we selected 126 contacts placed in the cortex, to continuously record cortical activity' (Bratu et al. 2021, Cortex 145:285-294, doi:10.1016/j.cortex.2021.08.018, section 2 'Patient and methods')
